question.text: Zinc call option: Strike Rs 180, Premium Rs 10. Market price at expiry is Rs 200. What is the call buyer's profit?

explanation.text: The Logic: Call buyer profit = (Market - Strike) - Premium = (200 - 180) - 10 = 20 - 10 = Rs 10. The Trap: Rs 20 is gross payoff before premium. Rs 30 adds premium instead of subtracting. Always deduct the premium paid to arrive at net profit.
